Roasted Nuts

Served at: All Hallows' Eve (Halloween)

Serves 4-6Prep 5 minCook 15-20 min

Roasted nuts are a quintessential autumn snack, perfect for warming up chilly All Hallows' Eve gatherings. Their earthy aroma and satisfying crunch make them a simple yet beloved treat, ideal for munching while telling spooky stories or awaiting trick-or-treaters.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups (240 g) mixed raw nuts (such as almonds, walnuts, pecans, cashews)
  • 1 tablespoon (15 ml) olive oil or melted unsalted butter
  • 1/2 teaspoon (2.5 g) sea salt, or to taste

Method

  1. Preheat your oven to 300°F (150°C).
  2. In a medium bowl, combine the raw nuts with the olive oil or melted butter, tossing until the nuts are evenly coated.
  3. Sprinkle the sea salt over the nuts and toss again to distribute evenly.
  4. Spread the seasoned nuts in a single layer on a large baking sheet.
  5. Bake for 15-20 minutes, stirring halfway through, until the nuts are fragrant and lightly golden brown. Be careful not to burn them.
  6. Remove from the oven and let the nuts cool completely on the baking sheet. They will become crispier as they cool.
  7. Serve immediately or store in an airtight container.

Tips

  • For a sweet variation, toss with 1 tablespoon (13 g) maple syrup and 1/2 teaspoon (1 g) cinnamon before roasting.
  • For a spicy kick, add 1/4 teaspoon (0.5 g) cayenne pepper and 1/2 teaspoon (1 g) smoked paprika along with the salt.
  • Ensure nuts are fully cooled before storing to prevent condensation and maintain crispness.
